title: A read-only krn command archives closed tasks inside a lane worktree
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16, worktree .krn/worktrees/outdated-instructions (lane start at b48b462): after a read-only krn-reader audit ran krn commands there (krn --help, krn ledger --last 3), git status showed tasks/archive/2026-11.jsonl +14 rows and 14 tasks/t-*.json deleted (t-0p8v557, t-1v46dxv, t-cbsn9kz, ...) that nobody asked for; reverted with git checkout -- tasks/.
Outcome: no read-only krn command (help, show, list, ledger) writes tasks/ in a worktree; archival happens only through an explicit krn task archive; a test asserts tasks/ is unchanged after the read-only verbs.
Proof: node --test test/task/archive-readonly.test.ts: pass (fixture worktree with tasks closed over 14 days; git status of tasks/ clean after the read-only verbs).
Files: src/task/archive.ts, src/task/store.ts
